description: This script is a FastAPI-related command-line tool using Typer for managing translation workflows, including translating markdown files, managing missing/outdated translations, and automating GitHub PR creation.

methods.name: dict[str,str] get_langs()
methods.description: Loads language names from a YAML file and caches the result.

methods.name: Path generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated language file based on source path.

methods.name: Path generate_en_path(*, lang: str, path: Path)
methods.description: Generates the English source path from a translated language file path.

methods.name: None translate_page( *, language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")], en_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(envvar="EN_PATH")], )
methods.description: Translates a markdown page from English to a specified language using an AI agent.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_all_en_paths()
methods.description: Yields all English markdown files in prioritized order.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_en_paths_to_translate()
methods.description: Yields markdown files that need translation, excluding non-translatable sections.

methods.name: list[str] list_llm_translatable()
methods.description: Lists all languages that can be translated with LLM support.

methods.name: None llm_translatable_json( language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, )
methods.description: Outputs a JSON list of translatable languages, filtered by input if specified.

methods.name: None commands_json( command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, )
methods.description: Returns JSON list of available command names, filtered by input if specified.

methods.name: list[Path] list_removable(language: str)
methods.description: Lists translated files in a language that are not present in English (i.e., can be removed).

methods.name: list[Path] list_all_removable()
methods.description: Lists all files in all languages that are removable.

methods.name: None remove_removable(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Deletes all files identified as removable in a specific language.

methods.name: None remove_all_removable()
methods.description: Deletes all removable files across all languages.

methods.name: list[Path] list_missing(language: str)
methods.description: Lists English files that are missing translations in a specified language.

methods.name: list[Path] list_outdated(language: str)
methods.description: Lists translation files that are older than their English source files.

methods.name: None update_outdated(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Re-translates outdated files in a language to current English sources.

methods.name: None add_missing(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Translates and adds missing files in a language.

methods.name: None update_and_add(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: Performs both updating outdated and adding missing translations.

methods.name: None make_pr( *, language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, github_token: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_TOKEN")], github_repository: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_REPOSITORY")], commit_in_place: Annotated[ bool, typer.Option(envvar="COMMIT_IN_PLACE", show_default=True) ] = False, )
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, automating commit and PR creation.

methods.name: list[str] get_llm_translatable()
methods.description: unavailable

methods.name: None translate_lang(language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")])
methods.description: unavailable

ctags.name: generate_en_path
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_en_path(*, lang: str, path: Path) -> Path:$/

ctags.name: generate_lang_path
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_lang_path(*, lang: str, path: Path) -> Path:$/

ctags.name: make_pr
ctags.signature: ( *, language: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")] = None, command: Annotated[str | None, typer.Option(envvar="COMMAND")] = None, github_token: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_TOKEN")], github_repository: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="GITHUB_REPOSITORY")], commit_in_place: Annotated[ bool, typer.Option(envvar="COMMIT_IN_PLACE", show_default=True) ] = False, )

ctags.name: translate_page
ctags.signature: ( *, language: Annotated[str, typer.Option(envvar="LANGUAGE")], en_path: Annotated[Path, typer.Option(envvar="EN_PATH")], )
